about: Per-frame reads of our towers' HP bars and numerals over live match runs/live/20261120-185026, frames f107..f2039 in order, run-length coded: [n frames, bar, numeral]; bar = [x0, y, fill, track, height] or null; numeral = [value, text, confidence, n_cells, occluded] or null. `reads` = hud_live.OwnTowerReader / OwnKing as of 2026-11-21 (red level badges flagged as occluded); `reads_before` = the reader before that day (a goblin's badge '11' over the numeral read as digits: 3052 as 312, 2052 as 217, ...). Feed them to the filters at hz 16.
